    draw(world, dt, quiet = false) {

    drawSideBackground() {

        const hills = [['#b5dcb7', .33, .55], ['#9bd4af', .51, .69], ['#7bc99b', .70, .83]];
        for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {

    drawSide(world) {

    drawQuestDetails(world, t) {
